findings.explanation: The English relocates respiratory distress into generic chest pain.

findings.evidenceJa: 胸の上から押さえつけた心臓
findings.governingReading: Sakura presses down on her heart through her chest.
findings.explanation: The English omits her physical attempt to restrain it.

findings.governingReading: The narration pivots from “she” into Sakura’s first-person “I” as resolve returns.
findings.explanation: The English omits the focalization shift.

findings.highlight: I need to settle my match
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に決着をつけなくてはいけない
findings.governingReading: Sakura must settle matters with herself.
findings.explanation: The English turns this into a malformed match and omits its object.

findings.highlight: look at him, like I do every night at dinner
findings.evidenceJa: 食事時のように顔を合わせて
findings.governingReading: Sakura imagines facing Zouken as ordinarily as at mealtime.
findings.explanation: The English invents a nightly shared-dinner routine.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしを回収したがっていた
findings.governingReading: Sakura believes Zouken wanted to retrieve or collect her as the Grail.
findings.explanation: The English reduces instrumental collection to wanting her back.
